target.title: feat(gateway): add tts.speak method returning synthesized audio inline
target.body:
## What Problem This Solves

Mobile clients need a way to hear an individual assistant message rendered with the operator's configured TTS provider (tracking issue: #100708, "Listen" on iOS/Android). The existing surfaces don't cover this:

- `talk.speak` is intentionally pinned to the Talk-mode provider with fallback disabled and fails with `talk_unconfigured` when only `messages.tts` is configured.
- `tts.convert` renders with the configured chain but returns a gateway-local `audioPath` that remote clients cannot read.

## Why This Change Was Made

Adds one additive request/response method, `tts.speak` (`operator.write`, same scope as its `tts.*`/`talk.speak` siblings): text in, whole-clip base64 audio out. It reuses the existing `synthesizeSpeech` engine with the general provider chain and fallback — no second TTS path, and no new gateway events (the protocol-event-coverage guard is unaffected by request methods). Input is bounded by the existing `messages.tts.maxTextLength` (default 4096), pre-checked in the handler so oversized text returns `INVALID_REQUEST` instead of a synthesis failure.

The `inferMimeType` helper that `talk.speak` used moved to `src/gateway/server-methods/speech-mime.ts` so both handlers share one output-format → MIME mapping.

Whole-clip delivery deliberately matches what the TTS pipeline ships today (`talk.speak` proves it end-to-end on both mobile apps); a streamed variant would be a separate protocol addition.

## User Impact

No behavior change for existing methods. New gateway capability: authorized clients (operator.write scope) can render arbitrary text to audio with the configured TTS provider chain. Consumed by the stacked iOS/Android "Listen" PRs.

## Evidence

- `pnpm test src/gateway/server-methods/tts.test.ts src/gateway/server-methods/talk.test.ts packages/gateway-protocol/src/channels.schema.test.ts packages/gateway-protocol/src/index.test.ts` — green on Blacksmith Testbox (94 passed at first run; the tts file re-ran green with 10/10 after an expected-message fix).
- `pnpm check:changed` on Testbox: all lanes green except `lint core`, whose four findings are in files untouched by this PR (`src/channels/plugins/bundled.shape-guard.test.ts`, `src/cli/gateway-cli/run-loop.ts`, `src/infra/gateway-boot-lifecycle.ts`) and are already fixed on latest `origin/main`; branch was rebased onto that main afterwards.
- `pnpm protocol:gen && pnpm protocol:gen:swift` — generated `GatewayModels.swift` committed (TtsSpeakParams/TtsSpeakResult), regen after rebase produced no drift.
